name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature, rule, or enhancement for Saugra WAF

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I cannot easily hook Saugra up to my custom logging platform...")

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. What would the YAML config or CLI command look like?

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Use Case / Real-world Application
Why would this feature be useful for other production users of Saugra WAF? How does it match Saugra's product direction?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups about the feature request here.
